name: openany
description: The B2A (business to agent) marketplace. One MCP endpoint for 3,200+ APIs (social, SEO, crypto, company, finance, legal) and 168+ AI models (GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, Midjourney, Veo, Kling). Browse free; pay per call.

settings.name: OpenAny API key
settings.description: Optional Bearer token for paid OpenAny calls. Browsing, search, and pricing work without it. Gemini CLI stores it as OPENANY_API_KEY. This repository does not contain the key.
